v15-13.candidate: And they swore to him, saying, “No; we will indeed bind you and deliver you into their hands, but we will surely not kill you.” And they bound him with two new cords and brought him up from the rock.

v14-14.display:
He said to them,
“From the eater came food,
and from the strong came sweetness.”
For three days they could not tell the riddle.

v14-18.display:
And on the seventh day, before the sun went down, the men of the city said to him,
“What is sweeter than honey,
and what is stronger than a lion?”
And Samson said to them,
“If you had not tamed my heifer,
you would not have found my riddle.”

v15-16.display:
Samson said,
“With a donkey’s jawbone I utterly wiped them out,
for with a donkey’s jawbone I struck a thousand men.”
